# AxiomEmbedded — Copilot instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` first (repository contract), then task-specific skills.
Prefer the artifact graph over whole-repo reads. Discover → plan →
select context → change → verify → evidence.

## MCP tools (via the `axiom-embedded` MCP server)

- `engage(domain, platform)` — skill slice for the project
- `run_plan(request, domain, platform)` — plan-then-execute plan
- `read_skill(skill_id)` / `list_skills` / `list_profiles` — discovery
- `context_select`, `impact`, `workflow_plan`, `route` — analysis

## Approval gates (configs/project.yaml)

Surface the plan first; never execute pushes, releases, destructive
commands, or safety/security-critical changes without recorded human
approval. Never claim certification or compliance from a heuristic check.
